title: Panicking parent, 3-year-old with fever having a seizure
tricky_aspects: operator must calm caller to get info

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Help me! Help, my son, he's shaking, he's shaking, oh my God please!

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I'm here to help. Tell me your address first.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I can only send help if I know where you are. What is the address?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, okay, Ringvägen 40, Staffanstorp, the white house!

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Ringvägen 40, Staffanstorp. Good. How old is your son?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: He's three. He had a fever all day, and now his eyes are rolled back and his arms are jerking.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Is he lying on the floor or the bed?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: On the bed. His lips look a bit blue, is he dying? Is he dying?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Help is on the way with sirens. Move anything hard away from him, don't put anything in his mouth, don't hold him down. How long has he been shaking?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I don't know, maybe two minutes? Three? It feels like forever.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Okay. Is it still going on now?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes... wait, it's slowing down... it stopped. He's not moving, he's breathing, he's breathing heavy.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Good. Turn him on his side, like this, top leg bent. Keep watching his breathing. Has he ever had a seizure before?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, never. He's never had anything.
